sentences.translation: 你有没有干净毛巾给我用？

sentences.sentence: They purposefully keep people misinformed and fearful through their control of the media.
sentences.translation: 他们有目的地通过所控制的媒体来误导和恐吓民众。

sentences.sentence: By adding this concept to our cognitive toolkit, Rushkoff argues, we will have a better chance of using technologies “consciously and purposefully” and of resisting that bias.
sentences.translation: 洛西科夫认为，意识到这种偏见的存在之后，人们将来更有可能“有意识有目的地”运用技术并抑制偏见。

sentences.sentence: the revolution that failed to dislodge the British in 1919
sentences.translation: 未能推翻英国统治的1919年革命

sentences.sentence: He never had a heart attack, but that surgery was similarly prompted by complaints about chest pain and shortness of breath.
sentences.translation: 他没有心脏病发作过，但是这个手术也同样被提示关于胸痛和气短的疾病。

sentences.sentence: A panic attack victim usually suffers at least four of the previously mentioned symptoms, while a heart attack victim often experiences only pain and shortness of breath.
sentences.translation: 一位恐怖症患者通常至少会有本文先前提到的上述四种症状，而心脏病发作时患者通常只有疼痛和呼吸短促。

sentences.sentence: She cannot accuse me of showing a bit of deceitful softness.
sentences.translation: 她不能控诉我说我表示过一点虚伪的温柔。

sentences.sentence: This body type is softer, so you want to contrast the softness of the body with some structure.
sentences.translation: 这种体型给人的感觉是柔软的，所以你想把身体的柔软和一部分体型结合起来。

translations.translation: 行为主义者, 行为科学家

sentences.sentence: And from a behaviorist point of view this is because of the associative history of these things.
sentences.translation: 在行为主义者看来,这是在这些事物之间的联结历史造成的。

sentences.sentence: As the behaviorist tells us, man can be thought of as "an assembled organic machine ready to run.
sentences.translation: 正如行为主义者告诉我们的，一个人被看作是“一台组装好的即将发动的机器”。

sentences.sentence: Starting from this manifest falsehood, the behaviorist proposes to operate the "human Ford" the way the operator drives his car.
sentences.translation: 从这个明显谬论开始，行为主义者设想着用驾驶员开车的方式驾驶我们这辆“人类福特”。

sentences.translation: 箔纸包的巧克力

phrases.translation: 紧迫的威胁；逼近的威胁

sentences.sentence: A new trade agreement is imminent.
sentences.translation: 一项新的贸易协定即将签署。

sentences.sentence: Pick a partner and practice passing, for if you pass proficiently, perhaps you'll play professionally.
sentences.translation: 选择一位队员练习传球，如果你能熟练地传球，你或许会成为一位专业球员。

sentences.sentence: Foreigners are not expected to use chopsticks proficiently, but if they do, they will give a mighty impression.
sentences.translation: 外国人不被期望能熟练地使用筷子，但如果他们这样做了，就会有很深的感触和体会。

sentences.sentence: “This form of behavior — independence, locomotor capacity, parental care and development — could be similar to the life history of the theropod,” he said.
sentences.translation: “这种行为形式，不管是独立性、运动能力，还是亲代抚育和发育过程，都与兽脚类恐龙的生活史相似，”他说。

sentences.sentence: “This form of behavior — independence, locomotor capacity, parental care and development — could be similar to the life history of the theropod, ” he said.
sentences.translation: 这种行为——独立、运动力、亲代抚育和成长——可能与兽脚亚目食肉恐龙的生命轨迹类似"，戴尔博士说。

sentences.sentence: a cloudy night with some light rain
sentences.translation: 伴有些许小雨的多云的夜晚

sentences.sentence: Tomorrow, it will be cloudy and cool.
sentences.translation: 明天多云，天气凉爽。

sentences.sentence: In terms of valuation, the run of strong earnings combined with declining stock prices translate into some attractively priced stocks.
sentences.translation: 在估值方面，强劲的盈利走势加上下跌的股价，其结果就是价格具有吸引力的股票。

sentences.sentence: the snowy fields
sentences.translation: 被雪覆盖的田野

sentences.sentence: one snowy January day
sentences.translation: 1月里大雪纷飞的一天

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 408 单元

pesky
音标：英 /'peskɪ/  美 /'pɛski/
adj. 讨厌的，烦人的
例句：Those pesky kids!
那些讨厌的孩子！

sorrowful
音标：英 /'sɒrə(ʊ)fʊl; -f(ə)l/  美 /'sɑrofl/
adj. 悲伤的，使人伤心的
例句：a sorrowful expression
悲伤的表情

overtone
音标：英 /'əʊvətəʊn/  美 /'ovɚ'ton/
n. 寓意；眩外音；暗示
例句：The strike has taken on overtones of a civil rights campaign.
这次罢工带有民权运动的意味。

towel
音标：英 /'taʊəl/  美 /'taʊəl/
n. 毛巾
短语：bath towel — 浴巾
短语：paper towel — 纸巾
短语：sanitary towel — 月经垫；卫生巾（等于sanitary napkin）
短语：towel rack — n. 毛巾架
短语：kitchen towel — 厨房用纸；洗碗布
短语：towel gourd — 丝瓜
短语：beach towel — 沙滩毛巾；沙滩浴巾；海滩浴巾
短语：throw in the towel — 认输
短语：terry towel — 毛巾织物
短语：tea towel — 擦拭杯盘用的抹布
短语：towel cloth — 毛巾布
短语：hand towel — 擦手巾
短语：towel factory — 毛巾厂；羊毛衫厂
短语：face towel — 毛巾；面巾；小方巾
例句：Have you got a clean towel I could use?
你有没有干净毛巾给我用？

purposefully
音标：英 /'pə:pəsfuli/  美 /'pə:pəsfuli/
adv. 有目的地, 蓄意地
例句：They purposefully keep people misinformed and fearful through their control of the media.
他们有目的地通过所控制的媒体来误导和恐吓民众。
例句：By adding this concept to our cognitive toolkit, Rushkoff argues, we will have a better chance of using technologies “consciously and purposefully” and of resisting that bias.
洛西科夫认为，意识到这种偏见的存在之后，人们将来更有可能“有意识有目的地”运用技术并抑制偏见。

dislodge
音标：英 /dɪs'lɒdʒ/  美 /dɪs'lɑdʒ/
v. 驱逐
例句：the revolution that failed to dislodge the British in 1919
未能推翻英国统治的1919年革命

lint
音标：英 /lɪnt/  美 /lɪnt/
n. 绷带用麻布

shortness
n. 短缺
短语：shortness of breath — 气促；呼吸浅短
例句：He never had a heart attack, but that surgery was similarly prompted by complaints about chest pain and shortness of breath.
他没有心脏病发作过，但是这个手术也同样被提示关于胸痛和气短的疾病。
例句：A panic attack victim usually suffers at least four of the previously mentioned symptoms, while a heart attack victim often experiences only pain and shortness of breath.
一位恐怖症患者通常至少会有本文先前提到的上述四种症状，而心脏病发作时患者通常只有疼痛和呼吸短促。

softness
音标：美 /'sɔftnɪs/
n. 柔和, 温柔
例句：She cannot accuse me of showing a bit of deceitful softness.
她不能控诉我说我表示过一点虚伪的温柔。
例句：This body type is softer, so you want to contrast the softness of the body with some structure.
这种体型给人的感觉是柔软的，所以你想把身体的柔软和一部分体型结合起来。

domestically
音标：英 /də'mestikəli/  美 /də'mɛstɪkli/
adv. 家庭式地,国内地

behaviorist
n. 行为主义者, 行为科学家
例句：And from a behaviorist point of view this is because of the associative history of these things.
在行为主义者看来,这是在这些事物之间的联结历史造成的。
例句：As the behaviorist tells us, man can be thought of as "an assembled organic machine ready to run.
正如行为主义者告诉我们的，一个人被看作是“一台组装好的即将发动的机器”。
例句：Starting from this manifest falsehood, the behaviorist proposes to operate the "human Ford" the way the operator drives his car.
从这个明显谬论开始，行为主义者设想着用驾驶员开车的方式驾驶我们这辆“人类福特”。

foil
音标：英 /fɔɪl/  美 /fɔɪl/
n. 箔, 金属薄片
短语：aluminum foil — [机]铝箔
短语：aluminium foil — 铝箔（作包装材料）；锡箔纸
短语：copper foil — 铜箔
短语：gold foil — 金箔
短语：metal foil — 金属箔
短语：foil paper — 箔纸，贴铝箔的纸基；衬底纸
短语：foil bag — 箔衬袋
短语：tin foil — n. 保鲜纸，锡纸
短语：foil mill — 箔材轧机
短语：silver foil — 银箔
短语：plastic foil — 塑料薄膜
例句：chocolates in foil wrappers
箔纸包的巧克力

newsworthy
音标：英 /'njuːzwɜːðɪ/  美 /'nuzwɝði/
adj. 有报导价值的
例句：newsworthy events
值得报道的事件

imminent
音标：英 /'ɪmɪnənt/  美 /'ɪmɪnənt/
adj. 逼近的, 即将发生的
短语：imminent danger — （法）迫在眉睫的危险
短语：imminent threat — 紧迫的威胁；逼近的威胁
例句：A new trade agreement is imminent.
一项新的贸易协定即将签署。

proficiently
adv. 熟练地
例句：Pick a partner and practice passing, for if you pass proficiently, perhaps you'll play professionally.
选择一位队员练习传球，如果你能熟练地传球，你或许会成为一位专业球员。
例句：Foreigners are not expected to use chopsticks proficiently, but if they do, they will give a mighty impression.
外国人不被期望能熟练地使用筷子，但如果他们这样做了，就会有很深的感触和体会。

locomotor
音标：英 /ləʊkə(ʊ)'məʊtə/  美 /'lokə'motɚ/
adj. 运动的
例句：“This form of behavior — independence, locomotor capacity, parental care and development — could be similar to the life history of the theropod,” he said.
“这种行为形式，不管是独立性、运动能力，还是亲代抚育和发育过程，都与兽脚类恐龙的生活史相似，”他说。
例句：“This form of behavior — independence, locomotor capacity, parental care and development — could be similar to the life history of the theropod, ” he said.
这种行为——独立、运动力、亲代抚育和成长——可能与兽脚亚目食肉恐龙的生命轨迹类似"，戴尔博士说。

cloudy
音标：英 /'klaʊdɪ/  美 /'klaʊdi/
adj. 多云的, 阴天的
短语：cloudy day — 阴天
短语：cloudy sky — 多云天空，阴天
短语：partly cloudy — 局部多云；少云
例句：a cloudy night with some light rain
伴有些许小雨的多云的夜晚
例句：Tomorrow, it will be cloudy and cool.
明天多云，天气凉爽。

wirephoto
n. 有线传真

attractively
adv. 有吸引力地，诱人地
例句：In terms of valuation, the run of strong earnings combined with declining stock prices translate into some attractively priced stocks.
在估值方面，强劲的盈利走势加上下跌的股价，其结果就是价格具有吸引力的股票。

snowy
音标：英 /'snəʊɪ/  美 /'snoɪ/
adj. 雪的, 多雪的
短语：snowy white — n. 雪白色
例句：the snowy fields
被雪覆盖的田野
例句：one snowy January day
1月里大雪纷飞的一天
